services.name: Account and Billing Support
services.description: Help customers pay bills, start, stop, or transfer natural gas service, and find payment assistance through clear residential account pathways.

services.name: Home Energy Services
services.description: Guide customers to equipment inspections and tune-ups, rebates and offers, natural gas benefits, and cooking resources for dependable home comfort.

services.name: Natural Gas Safety Guidance
services.description: Provide clear actions for suspected natural gas odors, including leaving immediately and calling 800-882-3377 from a safe location, plus guidance to contact 811 before digging.
